new_entities.name: DHEA replacement in women with Addison's disease
aliases: dehydroepiandrosterone in women with adrenal insufficiency
DHEA for women with primary adrenal insufficiency
new_entities.description: DHEA supplementation used in women with primary adrenal insufficiency who have adrenal androgen deficiency despite standard glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid replacement.

new_entities.name: Quality of life
new_entities.description: Health-related quality of life measured with generic or disease-specific instruments.

edges.effect_quant: The best pooled evidence shows only a small quality-of-life signal. A meta-analysis of 10 randomized placebo-controlled trials found a small HRQoL benefit with DHEA in women with adrenal insufficiency (effect size 0.21, 95% CI 0.08 to 0.33), but individual long-term Addison trials ranged from one improved SF-36 subscale to no significant subjective-health benefit.
edges.population: women with primary adrenal insufficiency, especially Addison's disease, receiving standard steroid replacement but remaining DHEA deficient
edges.mechanism: DHEA may modestly improve well-being through restoration of adrenal androgen precursors and downstream effects on mood, energy, and body composition, but the signal appears weak and inconsistent.
edges.summary: This is a classic mixed edge. DHEA is not completely inert, but the average benefit is small enough that the literature does not support routine use for all women with Addison's disease.
edges.caveats: Side effects are common and benefits appear heterogeneous across studies and domains. A small pooled effect should not be confused with a broad, clinically meaningful restoration of well-being for most patients.

evidence.citation: Alkatib AA et al 2009 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized placebo-controlled trials of DHEA treatment effects on quality of life in women with adrenal insufficiency.

effect_quant.comparator: health-related quality of life with DHEA versus placebo in women with adrenal insufficiency

evidence.citation: Gurnell EM et al 2008 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: Long-term DHEA replacement in primary adrenal insufficiency: a randomized, controlled trial. One SF-36 subscale improved, but fatigue, cognition, and sexual function did not.

evidence.citation: Lovas K et al 2003 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: Replacement of dehydroepiandrosterone in adrenal failure: no benefit for subjective health status and sexuality in a 9-month, randomized, parallel group clinical trial.
